description: highlight() (tests/common/mod.rs:1091) slices haystack with needle.len() (byte count from the original needle) but the match index comes from the lowercased haystack. If needle contains non-ASCII letters whose lowercase form has a different byte length (e.g. 'İ' → 'i̇'), or if the haystack contains multi-byte chars at the match boundary, then `&haystack[abs..abs + needle.len()]` can split a UTF-8 code-point and panic with 'byte index is not a char boundary'. Trigger: call highlight() with any haystack/needle pair where the Unicode-lowercased needle differs in byte length from the original needle.
title: highlight() panics on multi-byte UTF-8 in needle
